phase: source and evaluation protocol frozen before generation or compiler evaluation
data_source: Original synthetic expressions authored from public task semantics; no organizer hidden inputs or labels.
correctness_policy: Original per-expression rtol/atol; no tolerance changes or case removal based on PTX outcomes. Any generation-only repair must be disclosed before final artifact freeze.
performance_policy: No held-out timing or compiler evaluation until candidate source and policy hashes are frozen. If a held-out result changes policy, this corpus becomes development data and must not be reported as untouched evaluation.
